repos_data.description: ⚡️ Express inspired web framework written in Go
go-redoc is an embedded OpenAPI/Swagger documentation ui for Go using ReDoc

Generate OpenAPI 3.1 (Swagger) specs from Go source code — no annotations. Static analysis and call-graph tracing infer routes, params, request/response schemas for Gin, Echo, Chi, Fiber, Gorilla Mux and net/http. Deterministic YAML/JSON output for CI, plus a web UI and call-graph diagram.
Zero-dependency Go input validation, in-place normalization, and JSON Schema generation from struct tags.
Generate OpenAPI 3.1 specs from Go source code via static analysis — zero annotations, automatic framework detection
Production-grade Server-Sent Events (SSE) for Fiber v3. Event coalescing, priority lanes, topic wildcards, adaptive throttling, built-in auth, Prometheus metrics, graceful drain.

Live data-center, power-grid, energy, interconnection-queue, fiber, natural-gas & M&A intelligence for AI agents — 92 tools, 24,600+ facilities, 300+ markets scored daily (DCPI), 1,600+ tracked M&A deals, live grid telemetry across 49 regions. Off-market capacity via source_capacity. Remote MCP at dchub.cloud/mcp. Query & cite (CC-BY-4.0).
